facts.statement: Bobosaurus was named in 2006 by Fabio M. Dalla Vecchia with the type species B. forojuliensis.
facts.quote: Bobosaurus was named in 2006 by Fabio M. Dalla Vecchia and the type species is B. forojuliensis.

facts.statement: Researchers debate whether Bobosaurus is a pistosaurid or closer to Plesiosauria.
facts.quote: It may be a pistosaurid, or closer to Plesiosauria.

facts.statement: Bobosaurus was a relatively large animal exceeding 3 meters in length.
facts.quote: It was a relatively large animal, with more than 3 m in length.

facts.statement: Bobosaurus is classified within the order Nothosauria.
Bobosaurus belongs to the unranked family Pistosauroidea.
Bobosaurus lived during the Carnian stage of the Late Triassic, between 237 and 233.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Carnian (237 to 233.6 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Bobosaurus is an extinct genus of sauropterygian reptile related to plesiosaurs.
rejected.quote: Bobosaurus is an extinct genus of sauropterygian reptile related to plesiosaurs.
